title: Human Capital Consultant
description:
**Job Description:**

The Technical Consultant – Adrenaline HCM Implementation is responsible for configuring and implementing Adrenaline HCM for

the group companies across the GCC and other regions. This role involves working with HR, payroll and business teams to translate

their requirements into a working system, from requirements and solution design through configuration, testing, go-live and post

implementation support. The Technical Consultant brings hands-on configuration experience on a major HCM platform and will build

deeper expertise in Adrenaline HCM, ensuring that core HR and multi-country payroll solutions are delivered accurately, on time and

in line with local requirements.

**Key Responsibilities:**

• Run requirement-gathering workshops with HR, payroll and business stakeholders, and document current and future-state

processes.

• Prepare fit-gap analysis and solution design documents for the Adrenaline HCM configuration.

• Configure core HR modules, including organization structure, legal entities, pay groups, positions, employee data, and workflows

and approvals.

• Configure payroll elements, earnings and deductions, formulas, and country-specific rules for multi-country payroll (such as

Qatar, KSA, UAE, Jordan and the Philippines).

• Set up related modules as needed, such as time and attendance, leave, benefits, performance and self-service.

• Prepare data migration templates, and validate, cleanse and load employee and payroll master data.

• Support integrations with finance (ERP), banking (WPS) and third-party systems, working with technical teams.

• Plan and run unit testing, system integration testing, parallel payroll runs and user acceptance testing; track and resolve defects.

• Build standard and custom reports and dashboards.

• Prepare configuration documents, user manuals and training material, and deliver end-user and key-user training.

• Provide go-live, hyper-care and post-implementation support, including change requests and issue resolution.

• Coordinate with the Adrenaline vendor team on product issues, enhancements and releases.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs):**

1.
**Requirements and Solution Design**

•
**KPI:**
Obtain stakeholder sign-off on fit-gap and solution design documents for 100% of assigned modules within agreed

project timelines.

•
**KPI:**
Keep configuration rework caused by missed or misunderstood requirements below 10% of configured items.

•
**KPI:**
Document current and future-state processes for 100% of in-scope entities before configuration begins.

2.
**System Configuration and Payroll Accuracy**

•
**KPI:**
Ensure 95% of configured modules pass system integration testing with no critical defects in the first test cycle.

•
**KPI:**
Achieve 99.5% accuracy in parallel payroll runs, with all variances explained and resolved before go-live.

•
**KPI:**
Achieve 99% data accuracy in validated employee and payroll master data loads.

3.
**Go-Live and Post-Implementation Support**

•
**KPI:**
Ensure 100% of assigned go-lives take place on the planned date.

•
**KPI:**
Resolve 90% of hyper-care and post-implementation issues within the agreed SLA.

•
**KPI:**
Achieve an 85% satisfaction score from end users and key users on training and support.

4.
**Documentation, Knowledge and Development**

•
**KPI:**
Deliver 100% of configuration documents, user manuals and training material before go-live.•
**KPI:**
Complete Adrenaline HCM core module training within the first 6 months in the role.

•
**KPI:**
Close 100% of logged vendor product issues and change requests with documented outcomes.

**Qualifications:**

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related fields.

• 3–5 years of experience in HCM application configuration and implementation, including at least one full-cycle implementation

from requirements to go-live.

• Hands-on configuration experience on at least one major HCM platform, such as Adrenaline HCM, Workday, Oracle PeopleSoft,

SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM Cloud or a comparable product.

• Good understanding of HR processes, including hire-to-retire, organization management, compensation and leave.

• Experience with data migration, data validation and testing.

• Strong Excel skills (lookups, pivots, formulas) and working knowledge of SQL for data analysis and reporting.

• Experience writing functional and configuration documentation.

• Experience with Adrenaline HCM, and with payroll configuration including earnings, deductions, formulas and payroll validation

(preferred).

• GCC experience, including knowledge of local payroll and labor rules such as End of Service Benefits (EOSB), WPS, GOSI and

leave accruals (preferred).

• Experience with multi-country, multi-entity payroll implementations, and exposure to integrations using APIs, flat files or

middleware (preferred).

• Certification in Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM Cloud or a similar platform (preferred).

• Experience working with onshore and offshore teams across time zones (preferred).

• Clear written and spoken communication in English, including with senior stakeholders.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and meet tight deadlines.

• A collaborative, client-focused approach, and willingness to travel to GCC locations for workshops, go-live or support, as

needed.

title: Oracle DBA Administration Oracle DBA Administration
description:
Senior/Lead Oracle Database Administrator

REQUIREMENT SUMMARY

The Senior Oracle Database Administrator plays a critical role in managing and optimizing Oracle databases within a BFSI sector environment. This position requires a seasoned professional with a deep understanding of database architecture and performance tuning to ensure seamless operations and data integrity.

Description

- Minimum 9 years of experience in Oracle Database Administration, with expertise in Oracle RAC, RMAN, and Data Guard.

- Proven capability in managing large-scale enterprise Oracle databases and providing 24/7 production support in BFSI sector.

- Strong experience in performance tuning and optimization of Oracle databases, including use of OEM and other Oracle tools.

- Proficiency in database installation, configuration, upgrade, patching, and troubleshooting in both Linux/Unix environments.

- Experience with Oracle GoldenGate for data replication and ensuring data consistency across distributed databases.

- Familiarity with cloud database solutions, including AWS RDS, EC2, and S3, and cloud migration strategies.

- Strong problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills, with experience in leading DBA teams and coordinating across technical teams.

Key Responsibilities

- Manage Oracle databases across production, development, and test environments, ensuring high availability and reliability.

- Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and troubleshoot Oracle databases to maintain optimal performance and security.

- Provide 24/7 production support, managing incidents, performing root-cause analysis, and resolving critical database issues.

- Conduct performance tuning using AWR, ASH, SQL tuning, and execution-plan analysis to enhance database efficiency.

- Design and maintain Oracle RAC environments for high availability, ensuring seamless operations during failovers and switchover events.

- Configure and support Oracle Data Guard environments for disaster recovery, including regular DR drills and switchover tests.

- Perform database back-up and recovery operations using RMAN, ensuring data integrity and compliance with recovery objectives.

- Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business requirements and provide tailored database solutions, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Work Model & Flexibility:

· Candidates must be open to working in shift schedules, including US hours.

Interview Process:

· Screening-Welocity Octo AI Interview

· 1st Round: Virtual Technical interview with Project Team

· 2nd Round: Virtual

· Additional Requirement:

· Excellent communication skills

**Notice**
-15days to Officially 30 Days.

title: Senior Database Administrator
description:
